_comment: Homelab Bridge that imports a Homepage services.yaml (docs/SERVER-SETUP.md#import-from-homepage). Needs PyYAML. From the repo root, against the fake upstreams: start python3 server/fake_upstream.py server/recordings/<type>/normal.json --port <port> for uptime-kuma (8796), gatus (8797), proxmox (8798), pihole (8799), adguard (8800), sonarr (8801), radarr (8802) and qbittorrent (8803), then HOMELAB_TOKENS=<16+ characters> HOMEPAGE_VAR_KUMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:8796 HOMEPAGE_VAR_GATUS_HOST=127.0.0.1:8797 HOMEPAGE_VAR_PVE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8798 HOMEPAGE_VAR_PIHOLE_HOST=127.0.0.1:8799 HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_HOST=127.0.0.1:8800 HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8801 HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8802 HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_HOST=127.0.0.1:8803 and <anything> for HOMEPAGE_VAR_GATUS_PASSWORD, HOMEPAGE_VAR_PVE_SECRET, HOMEPAGE_VAR_PIHOLE_KEY, HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASSWORD, HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY, HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY and HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASSWORD: python3 server/reference_server.py --config server/examples/sources-homepage.json. For your own Homepage, set file to its services.yaml and give the bridge the same HOMEPAGE_VAR_ and HOMEPAGE_FILE_ variables as Homepage. The import never adds actions: an ad blocker's pause stays opt-in with "extra": {"Pi-hole": {"actions": {"pause": [5, 15, 30]}}}.
name: bridge homepage
